input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives each Party a right to terminate on 90 days' notice, but it sits inside the auto-renewal sentence, so the Company's convenience exit is arguably only a non-renewal mechanic; we add "at any time" to put the Company's convenience right in operative terms while retaining the 90-day period. Two further fallback elements fail: (i) HDI's right is not tied to the end of the then-current term (its notice may fix any Termination Date), so HDI can walk away mid-term; and (ii) the Termination Payment triggered by the Company's termination is an uncapped formula (aggregate Net Sales for the preceding twelve months less $800,000, divided by two, payable in eight quarterly instalments) that can far exceed three months of fees. We therefore target the fallback with the shortest edits: an "at any time" clarifier, an HDI term-end limit scoped to Section 4.1 (with the Termination Date conformed so the retained notice mechanic does not contradict it), and a cap at three months of the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3 (the fee section is a revenue share on Net Sales, so "amounts payable" avoids a nil or undefined cap). HDI's 90-day notice period is already met; the preferred 30-day notice and pro-rata refund of prepaid fees are accepted shortfalls and not redlined.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 to 90 days' notice.
Any early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
Vendor may terminate for convenience only at the end of a term.
Vendor must give at least 90 days' notice of convenience termination.

proposal.summary: Confirm the Company may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term, and cap the Termination Payment at three months' amounts payable under Section 3.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have confirmed that the Company's 90-day termination right in Section 4.1 may be exercised at any time (not only as a non-renewal), limited HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term so it cannot walk away mid-term, and capped the Termination Payment at three months of the amounts payable to HDI under Section 3.

ops.text: Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term, and any Termination Date specified in HDI's notice shall be the last day of that term.
In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the amounts payable by the Company to HDI under Section 3 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
